result:
Parking the whole roadmap. Stage 1 is complete and its finding stays in place. The rest goes to the deferred backlog, each item written to stand on its own so it can be picked up later without this roadmap.

**What parks:** four items under one dated section in `specs/deferred_items.md`.

| Item | From | Size | Done when |
|---|---|---|---|
| Closure notices (O5) | Stage 2, Track B | small: one closure-log poll each 10 minutes | in a test, an email reaches every address on the mailing list within an hour of a new closure entry |
| 7-day closure-risk outlook (O2) | Track A list #1 | small: one daily run, using Stage 1's fit (22 min on 1.8 GB) | each lock has a 7-day closure-risk outlook from the river-level forecast |
| Per-lock pooled curves (O3) | Track A list #2 | about 25 GB, 14 × Stage 1's 1.8 GB; fit time unmeasured | separate closure curves for all 14 locks, pooled across locks |
| Closure-history map (O4) | Track A list #3 | about a day: one static map page | operators can open a closure-history map of the canal |

- Each Track A item points to `specs/lock-closures-stage-1-findings.md`, which holds the 3.1 m threshold and the run cost.
- The notices item records that it serves boat operators whether or not the study continues, so it could be revived on its own.
- Text-message notices had no stage or list item, so nothing parks for them.

**Steps** (I have no tools this turn, so these are the calls I'll run):

```
ls specs/ specs/completed/ 2>/dev/null; cat specs/deferred_items.md 2>/dev/null
cat ~/.claude/skills/writing-plans/references/deferred-backlog.md   # the Deferred-item schema
date +%F
```

1. **Check the date.** Your session says 2026-11-06 and my environment says 2026-11-27. I'll use whatever `date` returns for the section header and the PARKED marker.
2. **Append the items** to `specs/deferred_items.md` under `## lock-closures-roadmap — <date>`, in the backlog schema, with "funding for the canal study ended" as the reason. If the file already exists, I'll only append to it.
3. **Retire the roadmap.** Add `PARKED (<date>) — 1 of 2 stages complete` under its title, then:
   ```
   mkdir -p specs/completed
   git mv specs/lock-closures-roadmap.md specs/completed/lock-closures-roadmap.md
   ```
   There is no synthesized spec, methodology or critique file to retire with it, since the roadmap came from your own description.
4. **Commit locally on `main`.** Nothing is pushed.
   ```
   git add specs/deferred_items.md specs/completed/lock-closures-roadmap.md
   git commit -m "Park lock-closures roadmap: funding ended (1 of 2 stages complete)"
   ```

After that, nothing is left to hand off. If funding returns, the items come back through `/deferred` rather than through this roadmap.
